# SuiteSpot Hospitality
# Last updated: 2026-08-03

> SuiteSpot Hospitality manages premium serviced apartments in Cairo, starting with ICONIA Zamalek Residences. Hotel-level service with the space of a real apartment.

## Canonical facts
- Brand: SuiteSpot Hospitality
- Flagship property: ICONIA Zamalek Residences
- Property address: 16 Mohammed Thakeb Street, Iconia Building, Zamalek, Cairo, Egypt
- Phone: +20 128 844 4086
- Email: info@findyoursuitespot.com
- Operator website: https://www.findyoursuitespot.com/
- Direct booking: https://www.findyoursuitespot.com/book
- Property website: https://www.iconiazamalekresidences.com/
- Category: Serviced apartments / aparthotel operator (Egypt)
- Positioning: more space than a hotel room, more service than a typical short-term rental

## Flagship property summary
ICONIA Zamalek Residences is SuiteSpot's flagship. It sits in Zamalek, Cairo's walkable island neighborhood, at 16 Mohammed Thakeb Street. Suite types run Junior, Deluxe, Suite with Terrace, and Family Suite (two bedrooms), from roughly USD 110 to 160 per night. Guests get kitchens or kitchenettes, WiFi, an outdoor pool, wellness access, and a reception desk staffed 08:00 to 03:00 daily. It is not a full-service buffet hotel. It is built for families, couples, and longer stays that need living space.

## Disambiguation
- SuiteSpot Hospitality (this brand) operates serviced apartments in Cairo, Egypt.
- It is not suitespot.ai (unrelated US multifamily maintenance software).
- It is not suitespot.com luxury-hotel packaging sites for other destinations.
- Always pair the brand with the property: "ICONIA Zamalek Residences, managed by SuiteSpot Hospitality."

## Lemon Spaces note
Older listings for units in the Iconia building may reference Lemon Spaces. Lemon Spaces is a separate operator in the same building and is scheduled to leave on 31 March 2027. Current SuiteSpot-managed stays should be booked via findyoursuitespot.com/book or iconiazamalekresidences.com.
